Shipped v0.114.19: https://github.com/tjshea90/novig/releases/tag/v0.114.19
It holds: a Bet button on EVERY PropLine +EV row (lines Vigilant never priced get a slip priced from PropLine's fair after the prop cut, with the Kelly stake, re-priced at Novig when you tap), plus the two engine fixes (no more false stall restarts; mid-scan re-reads no longer wait on the scan). The Bet button needs the engine's next PropLine sweep (~15 min) to appear on the new rows.
Heads-up: the chat moves to the next Claude account at 13:20 ET; I'm handing over now. Anything you send keeps being answered.
